tests.title: parses radius/r, planes/p and sigma/s with native defaults, shorthand order, aliases, integer expressions and last-wins keys
declares the native pix_fmts in declared order, all five paths and keeps geometry
blends the clipped window mean and variance exactly like the native summed-area tables
matches a literal BigInt summed-area port over random planes, clipped radii and the BigInt variance range
rejects unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, invalid settings and cancellation explicitly
plans yaepblur on every path with packed-alpha and oversized refusals and runtime commands refused
runs the locally built native reference at the pinned commit without x86 assembly
matches native yaepblur kernels across formats, sizes, radii, sigmas, planes, patterns and native thread counts
matches native yaepblur CLI rawvideo and framecrc outputs across conversions and timing
matches native complex yaepblur graphs on the frame-graph path
matches native replayed yaepblur streams frame by frame
matches native yaepblur through the timed backend actor and pull schedulers
fails like native for unknown and out-of-range yaepblur options and refuses enable= and runtime commands before opening outputs
negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses the packed-alpha gbrap picks before output on every path

unsupported: Negotiated formats without frame storage here (every >8-bit member, yuv440p, yuvj440p, yuv411p, yuvj411p, yuv410p, yuva444p, yuva422p, gbrap); native picks gbrap from argb/rgba/abgr/bgra and those are refused by name before output
enable= timeline expressions and the generic threads/thread_type/extra_hw_frames options (native accepts them)
Runtime commands radius/planes/sigma (native AV_OPT_FLAG_RUNTIME_PARAM); refused with ENOSYS on the actor path
Planes with 255*w*h >= 2^32 (gray 4096x4113 and up), where native's uint64 sum*sum could wrap

proposedContracts.name: matches native yaepblur kernels across formats, sizes, radii, sigmas, planes, patterns and native thread counts
proposedContracts.scope: 8-bit planar gray/yuv420p/yuv422p/yuv444p/yuva420p/gbrp at 1x1..17x9 and 64x48; radius/planes/sigma incl. native radius clipping, r=0 and p=0 copies, s=1 and s=2^31-1; native default threads equal -filter_threads 1. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

proposedContracts.name: matches native yaepblur CLI rawvideo and framecrc outputs across conversions and timing
proposedContracts.scope: -vf linear chains with implicit conversions (-cpuflags 0), rawvideo and framecrc, with and without -ss/-t. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

proposedContracts.name: matches native complex yaepblur graphs on the frame-graph path
proposedContracts.scope: -filter_complex graphs with split, hflip, transpose and chained yaepblur, two outputs. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

proposedContracts.name: matches native replayed yaepblur streams frame by frame
proposedContracts.scope: createReplayVideoExecution frame by frame incl. hstack joins. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

proposedContracts.name: matches native yaepblur through the timed backend actor and pull schedulers
proposedContracts.scope: Timed backend producer, activation and pull schedulers, rawvideo and framecrc. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

proposedContracts.name: fails like native for unknown and out-of-range yaepblur options and refuses enable= and runtime commands before opening outputs
proposedContracts.scope: Unknown, out-of-range and non-numeric options with native status and wording (host ERANGE text for native); enable= and generic options refused; no output opened on media -vf, -filter_complex and timed producer/pull. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

proposedContracts.name: negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses the packed-alpha gbrap picks before output on every path
proposedContracts.scope: 17 sources: 13 byte-exact on every path (yuvj on linear chains), argb/rgba/abgr/bgra refused as gbrap before output. Wave 2 branch wave2/vf-yaepblur.

notes: Integer only; no linux-gated cases. The native summed-area tables are read as running column sums (sat[higher_y]-sat[lower_y] per row), O(width) scratch; every window sum equals native's uint64 value exactly. A unit test compares against a literal BigInt port of the full native tables, including a plane that takes the BigInt sum*sum branch (on that data the double branch would also agree).
Native filters in place when the frame is writable; each output pixel reads only its own source sample, so the result is identical.

Setup durations: bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) 4m22s with Node 24.22.3 from /opt/node24 (the sandbox default Node 22.23.5 is refused by the bootstrap); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test 1m21s, all green.
Differential file runs in about 12 s with --maxWorkers=1.
